# Independent Reproduction: Connes-Consani-Moscovici "Zeta Spectral Triples" (arXiv:2511.22755), lambda=3, N=120

Full pipeline reproduced from scratch (mpmath, dps 205): Weil-form matrix via the
Loewner a/b structure (Lemma 5.1), all special-function formulas re-implemented and
verified against direct quadrature before use, parity-reduced 121x121 even block,
custom 200-digit LU + inverse iteration for the near-kernel, roots of the
Fourier-transform rational function S(z).

RESULT: all 20 reported |eigenvalue - gamma_k| values of their Figure 1 reproduced
to every stated figure (1.58e-34 vs 1.6e-34 ... 2.42e-7 vs 2.4e-7).

Their Theorem 1.1 ASSUMPTIONS verified numerically at (lambda=3, N=120):
- smallest eigenvalue eps_N = 2.954e-38, SIMPLE: gap ratio eps/lambda_2 = 1.4e-7
  (lambda_2 = 2.15e-31); consistent with Figure 4 scale at mu = 9
- eigenvector EVEN: odd-block smallest eigenvalue 1.13e-34 >> eps_N

Transcription corrections required (caught by quadrature verification, likely
PDF-extraction artifacts, resolved by measurement not guesswork):
- (4.4): integrand is [e^{x/2} omega(x) - omega(0)]/(e^x - e^{-x}); grouping the
  weight as e^{x/2}(omega - omega(0)) shifts every diagonal entry by exactly
  2c(L) = 1.15043876932 (c(L) = int_0^L (e^{x/2}-1)/(e^x-e^{-x}) dx), which
  buries the near-kernel. Diagnosed via the constant degenerate spectrum bottom.
- The printed closed form for c(L) does not equal the integral; the quadrature
  value was used throughout.
- Basis bookkeeping: even-block coordinates carry 1/sqrt(2) into V-coordinates
  for j >= 1; omitting it destroys the zero approximation entirely (O(1) errors)
  while keeping all roots real - a vivid demonstration that REALITY of the
  spectrum is structural (Caratheodory-Fejer/self-adjointness) while ACCURACY
  of the zeros lives in the fine structure of xi.

The 200-digit near-kernel vector xi (even-block coordinates, j = 0..120) and
eps_N follow.
